messages:
kim: quick ping — PR #8342 updating REST client error mapping + streaming header ordering. breaking change for toolcall streaming? can someone take a look before EOD? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8342 :hourglass:

alex: @kim taking a look now, will focus on the streaming ToolCall path. any specific regression you saw?

kim: logs showed toolcall streams failing with 400 when clients send duplicated 'x-rw-...' headers. test added in pr — snippet:
```
# failing test
resp = client.streaming_toolcall(..., headers={"x-rw-client": "1", "x-rw-client": "1"})
assert resp.status == 200
```

raf: assigning to me for an initial pass :eyes: i'll check kernel of header merge + tests. gonna run local integration

riley: heads up — if we're changing header dedupe behavior we should note in SDK changelog and compat docs. cc @jen for release window.

raf: quick note from local run — header order matters in our response matching. left two review comments about normalizing header keys. small nit: prefer util.normalize_headers() to live in clients/http.py

alex: lgtm on tests, one question about backcompat with older proxies. can we add a toggle to preserve legacy behavior?

kim: i'd prefer gradual rollout. add config 'preserve_legacy_header_merge' default false. then Dedicated can enable as needed.

jen: release schedule: cutting release on Friday at 16:00 UTC. if PR merges before 12:00 UTC we can include it in 0.13.2. otherwise next patch.

raf: made suggested changes and pushed patch. @alex @kim can you re-review? PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8342

alex: reviewed, approved. :shipit:

kim: thanks all — merging after CI green. I'll cherry-pick to release branch if merged before cutoff.

github-bot: merged pull request #8342 into main by kim

kim: merged and cherry-picked to release/0.13.x. Thanks! :tada:
